title: Sagrada Familia.
text: Email was unclear where to meet.  The tour however was great.  Sagrada Familia is overwhelmingly gorgeous.   Gaudi was a genius. A must see for anyone visiting Barcelona.  PLAN EARLY.
author: Kmo1950

title: The guide was very good...
text: The guide was very good and knowledgeable. The outside and interior was breathtaking. The only downside is that it was too shout. I would have liked to have seen the interior upper levels of the Nativity and the Passion
author: Richard_M

title: The guide Hime was very...
text:
The guide Hime was very knowledgeable 
It was an incredible experience 
Not to be missed

The address for the Sagrada Familia was wrong but we managed to find our group at the last minute.  Perhaps giving the location as Julie Travel with the address would be helpful.

title: Great Tour! 😊
text: It was a beautiful Tour, the guides were knowledgeable and friendly! Both locations were amazing! Highly recommended!

title: Great experience
